definitions.explanation: The person who controls or manages an operation from behind the scenes. Often implies the top figure in an organization, especially one with shady or informal power structures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{元締|もとじ}めだ。
examples.english: He is the boss of this organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{密輸|みつゆ}→密輸：20266_mitsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{元締|もとじ}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついに⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The ringleader of the smuggling operation was finally arrested.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{元締|もとじ}め⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{片付|かたづ}け⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧すべて⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{仕切|しき}っている→取り仕切る：11946_torishikiru⟧。
examples.english: As the organizer of the local festival, she oversees everything from preparation to cleanup.

notes:
Originally referred to the person who controlled the source (⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧) of goods or money. In Edo-period Japan, it denoted the head of a trade guild or the person who managed the distribution of licensed goods.

In modern usage, the word often carries a negative connotation, suggesting someone who pulls the strings behind an illegal or semi-legal operation. However, it can also be used neutrally for anyone who is the central organizing figure of an activity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{元締|もとじ}め: criminal ringleader
- ⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{元締|もとじ}め: shadowy mastermind
- ⟦{興行|こうぎょう}→興行：13985_kougyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{元締|もとじ}め: entertainment promoter/organizer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{黒幕|くろまく}→黒幕：15478_kuromaku⟧: puppet master, behind-the-scenes manipulator — emphasizes secrecy and manipulation
- ⟦{親分|おやぶん}→親分：16957_oyabun⟧: boss (of a gang) — more specifically a yakuza or gang leader
- ⟦{首謀者|しゅぼうしゃ}→首謀者：19171_shubousha⟧: mastermind, instigator — formal term for the person who plans a crime
